split._source: plan rev3 sec.1 (D5 bank 3,000; cal 500; test 1,000; L3 3,000 for A4). Questions deduplicated by normalised title within a site before the split (our choice: exact-duplicate titles would put a query's own text in the bank)

tags._source: D7; levels fixed 2026-10-06 before P19 step 0 (P19 config). Sample = questions not drawn as queries (test/cal), fixed seed

category_alias._source: dump name writers = page name writing.stackexchange.com (MANIFEST A0)

subset._source: plan rev3 sec.1, our choice: ~30 sites as 10 tag-nearest triples, category-balanced; professional (3) and business (1) excluded (too few sites). Rule fixed before any A-series result

encode._source: plan rev3 sec.1: bge-m3 all 87 sites; contriever banks of all 87 (2nd-priority distance, cross-embedding clusters); subset roles for A5. Retriever settings (pooling, dtype, max_len, query prefix) from the P4 config; queries (test, cal) get the query prefix, documents none

_exclude_source: user decision 2026-10-06 (A1 pre-run review): rus is ~80% Russian text (non-ASCII share of titles 0.83, bank 0.79); it breaks the same-platform same-format premise (analysis sec.4) and acts as an inert bank for English queries. Excluded from every role; 86 sites remain
